## What I inspected and verified

Complete catalogs were parsed for source equality; that does **not** constitute mechanical approval of every other catalog entry.

| Original question range | Identities accounted for | Mechanical directions | Receipt-only |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| IL-01–26 | 26 | 26 | 0 |
| UN-01–23 | 23 | 23 | 0 |
| TR-01–29 | 29 | 29 | 0 |
| NE-01–30 | 30 | 30 | 0 |
| EV3-01–08 | 8 | 8 | 0 |

The actual verification results are:

| Verification | Result |
|---|---|
| Read-only archive, preservation, source, access, Core, book and receipt comparisons | **3,476 passed; zero failures** |

## Governing decisions

The complete wording is in **LR-G01–20** and the individual **LR-IL / UN / TR / NE / EV3 / R3** entries. The following are the principal decisions and explicit source conflicts.

### 1. Preserve actual access, costs and distinct permissions

**KEEP** every actual ordinary class-access row: school, rank, minimum class level, base RP and additional RP. Enough RP does not confer access, preparation, repertoire or a higher-rank variant.

An already completed, explicitly named ordinary-spell access exception—such as the actual Druid Circle always-prepared table—retains its own acquisition, rank and preparation requirements once its matching ordinary payload passes exact review. It does not rewrite the ordinary `classAccess` object.

Ordinary spell permissions remain distinct from same-named class techniques, ancestry grants, crafted-item uses and Oracle Revelations. Their costs, components, action windows and resource histories do not merge.

**KEEP** the existing casting, Counterspell, Dissonance, Refrain, concentration, damage, healing, condition and equipment procedures. New defaults apply only where the selected spell lacked an operating procedure.

### 2. Resolve the actual source alternatives without deleting them

| Source conflict | Binding decision |
|---|---|
| **Prestidigitation — IL-06** | Keep both school modes. Actual **Illusion** access selects the bounded concentration-based illusion procedure; actual **Universal** access selects the instantaneous harmless-operation procedure. They are not freely interchangeable modes. |
| **Uncontrollable Laughter — IL-18** | Explicitly bind the matching historical **Tasha’s Hideous Laughter** Core metadata to the current catalog identity. Preserve both names in provenance; do not create another spell identity. |
| **Resonance Tether — UN-13** | Likewise bind the matching historical **Mana Tether** metadata, without granting another identity or a shared RP pool. |
| **Phantasmal Force — IL-24** | Author the currently assigned **rank-2** mode. Preserve the rank-3 alternative as unassigned, not an automatic upcast. |
| **Stone Shape — TR-24** | Author the currently assigned **rank-2, 5-foot-range** mode. Preserve the rank-4 alternative without inventing class access to it. |
| **Mislead — R3-05** | Author the currently assigned **rank-3** mode; preserve the rank-5 alternative as unassigned. |
| **Echo Cast — UN-21** | Select Core’s precise **base-RP waiver**. Surcharges, additional costs, components and the later Action remain payable. |
| **Soul Tap — NE-16** | Retain the catalog’s **HP AND Resonance** clause through the joint, conserved operation described below. |
| **Unravel Spell — R3-19** | “Tier 4” means the generating ordinary spell’s actual **rank ≤4**, not equipment, material or creature tier. |

The register also resolves each individual duration, targeting and resolution gap beside the original fields. An original `Instantaneous` value is not silently rewritten to pretend it contained the new finite rider duration.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="7"}[Complete conflict dispositions and per-question mappings](sandbox:/mnt/data/low_rank_reviewer/LR_SOURCE_CONFLICT_DISPOSITIONS.json)

### 3. Adopt all eight proposals as NEW source directions—not exact approvals

Each proposal was considered with its complete original record and four supplied boundary cases. **All eight receive explicit source-authoring adoption**, with the complete limits in their respective entries. Their original unapproved proposal objects remain unchanged as historical evidence.

| Question / spell | Adopted finite operation |
|---|---|
| **IL-02 — Silent Echo** | One playback of no more than six seconds from an actual qualifying phrase heard within the previous minute and the specified 10-foot source range. A longer utterance can supply its genuinely heard final complete word or bounded phrase segment. No reconstructed inaudible ending, meaning, authentication or caster V. |
| **IL-05 — Blurred Visage** | Self-only, one-round **+2 AC half-cover equivalent against qualifying visually targeted ranged attacks**. No DEX-save bonus, melee protection or physical screen; real cover does not add to it. |
| **IL-07 — Minor Disguise** | Up to three localized cosmetic changes for one minute. No height, silhouette, anatomy, voice, tactile or equipment-function change. |
| **IL-08 — Phantom Footsteps** | One audible sequence, at most six seconds along a straight path no longer than 30 feet. No tracks, pressure, creature or compelled response. |
| **IL-09 — Shadow Mark** | At most three outstanding marks, one hour each. Caster-only visibility still requires actual sight; no beacon, through-wall detection or renewed mark on a replacement object. |
| **IL-26 — Silence** | Fixed center within 20 feet; **20-foot-radius acoustic field**, concentration up to one minute. It blocks sound according to actual paths and locations, not all mental techniques. No thunder immunity, vacuum or permanent condition is added. |
| **UN-16 — Magic Thread** | At most three waiting, one-use threads for one hour, using the finite light/symbol/chime/tap menu and actual touch or phonetic trigger. No stored parent spell or reusable charge. |
| **UN-23 — Magic Mouth** | At most three waiting, one-use mouths for 24 hours, reproducing the caster’s actual message of no more than six seconds. Touch, phonetic and ordinary visual triggers have explicit ranges; none supplies intelligence, identity verification or device-control authority. |

These eight do **not** replace or reduce the scope of the other 129 identity dispositions.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="8"}[Eight complete proposal dispositions and their 32 boundaries](sandbox:/mnt/data/low_rank_reviewer/LR_8_PROPOSAL_DISPOSITIONS.json)

### 4. Give copying and delayed casting real action and resource histories

**NEW — LR-G13 and UN-05/14/17/21:**

**Cantrip Echo** is one composite Bonus Action casting of the eligible payload. It uses the payload’s ordinary spell ID for its actual casting history, rather than inserting a wrapper name to reset Refrain. It makes a fresh legal attack/save where required; it does not replay a saved successful result.

**Quick Cast** spends its own Bonus Action to prepare a conversion on the caster’s **next regular turn**. It does not supply two Bonus Actions in the preparation turn. The later payload consumes that turn’s real Bonus Action and pays its actual costs.

**Delay Spell** has separate arming and payload commitments. Holding the already committed payload uses concentration for no more than six seconds. Targets and selections are locked; release revalidates current range, line and eligibility. Release is not a second casting or a new Counterspell window.

**Echo Cast** is separately paid arming followed by a real Action replay on the next regular turn. Only base RP is waived.

These wrappers cannot recursively take one another or an already replayed payload as replay fuel. Existing acquired class exceptions retain their own actual predicates; they are not automatically absorbed into this wrapper family.

### 5. Keep different invisibility and control endings different

**Ordinary Invisibility, IL-22, retains its printed action-ending clause.** The NEW precise boundary is before commitment of an Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. It does not automatically end merely from movement or another event that is not such an action.

That rule is **not** imposed on Cloak of Shades, Mislead, Shadow Dive, Dreamer’s Veil or other distinct class sources. Each keeps its own specified ending.

Consequently, ordinary IL-22 alone does not satisfy **Unseen Hand’s** requirement to take an Action **while Invisible**: this spell has already ended at the relevant commitment. An independently acquired invisibility source that actually persists through that Action can still qualify under the class card and its shared budget.

**Haste, R3-12, receives one explicitly named exception.** It retains its printed extra **full Action**, rather than an imported restricted action menu, while respecting the existing one-extra-full-Action-per-creature-per-numbered-round limit.

Its ending Stun is retained as a **NEW informed, voluntarily accepted buff-ending cost**, not another hostile hard-control claim. Actual expiry, concentration loss, dispel, replacement or dismissal triggers it; temporary suppression alone does not. Actual Stunned immunity still applies. This exception does **not** extend to other hostile denial effects.

### 6. Reflection redirects one effect; it does not create another cast

**NEW — LR-G14, Spell Mirror and Soul Mirror:**

The first eligible resolving ordinary spell with the protected creature as its **sole direct creature recipient** can be intercepted, whether beneficial or hostile. A Touch spell can qualify through this explicit magical return when the original caster is otherwise a legal recipient.

Area, multitarget, self-only, object/anchor, summoning, ongoing-tick and already redirected effects do not qualify.

The original caster remains the spell owner and supplies its statistics. The ward spends before the returned effect resolves. **An illegal or blocked return spends the ward but leaves the original recipient; it does not cancel the spell for free.** A causal root can be redirected only once by these two spells. A second mirror neither redirects nor consumes itself on that already redirected root.

### 7. Preserve finite damage, corpses, material and created bodies

Every ongoing damage spell now has an explicit number of checkpoints, ending procedure and suppression treatment. Suppressed scheduled ticks are spent, not banked for later. Extra turns do not manufacture more regular-turn ticks.

**Soul Tap** uses one d6 for the damage and both transfer ceilings. Its NEW transfer funding requires actual underlying normal-HP loss to a genuinely hostile living nonconstruct opponent. HP recovery is bounded by that actual loss and ordinary healing limits. RP transfer is separately bounded by the same roll, the donor’s actual available RP and the caster’s actual missing RP after payment. **RC is not RP.**

These new funding choices do not retrospectively rewrite the nonidentical completed Lifedraw, Vampiric Touch or feat procedures.

**Pact of Bone’s “+2 necrotic resist”** becomes a NEW flat reduction of two, not another resistance percentage. Its new reduction stage is expressly placed after the save amount and before passive resistance/vulnerability.

Corpse questions, corpse preservation, animation and ordinary harvesting retain distinct histories. Gentle Repose does not restart a death timestamp or a question/admission deadline. New corpse-fueled assets do not leave a fresh resource pool when their terminal history says the original matter was consumed.

Shadow Blade, Phantom Steed, Corpse Puppet, Summon Bone Archer, Summon Dreadknight and Animate Dead receive their own finite body, defense, movement, attack or noncombat-task, capacity, command and ending profiles. **No unsupplied monster stat block, equipment, ammunition, corpse loot or autonomous production is imported.**

Material transformations retain actual mass lineage, damage, ownership and old acquisition claims. Enlarge/Reduce does not compound repeated magical snapshots or refill HP. Stone Shape supplies bounded elementary shapes from actual stone, not a free fine mechanism, repaired structure or authored crafting result.

### 8. Keep literal short ranges and every printed damage expression

Several source choices are unusual but are **not corrected to another game’s familiar version**:

- **Fireball:** its actual **20-foot casting range** remains distinct from its 20-foot radius.
- **Minute Meteors:** six committed centers remain within the literal **5-foot casting range**. The NEW operation resolves six instantaneous, separately rolled 2d6 bursts, not a stored remote launcher.
- **Absorb Elements:** the source **Action** becomes a finite prepared defensive ward, not an imported Reaction.
- **Primal Savagery:** the literal 30-foot range is retained through a NEW momentary spell-local claw extension for one spell attack, not permanent natural-weapon reach.

The complete rows provide target admission, saves, damage-on-success, overlap, aftermath and termination. Descriptive tags such as **Ward**, **Healing** or **Damage** do not independently add an effect absent from the actual clause.

## Worked boundary outcomes

The full package contains an example for every identity. These illustrate the main combined boundaries.

| Boundary | Required authored outcome |
|---|---|
| **Color Spray:** seeing creatures have normal HP 2, 3, 5 and 8; the HP-2 creature also has 30 temporary HP and blindness immunity | Select the first three using normal HP and the fixed tie order. Temporary HP does not rerank them. Immunity prevents blindness on the selected immune creature but does not free a slot for the fourth. No save is invented. |
| **Soul Tap:** caster starts at 6 RP, pays 2, rolls 4; legal donor has 3 normal HP and 2 available RP | At most 3 HP recovery, subject to actual healing limits, and 2 RP transfer. The donor really loses that RP. No fourth HP, imaginary additional RP or RC conversion. |
| **Echo Cast:** replay normally costs 3 base RP plus a current surcharge of 1 | The replay still costs **1 RP**, plus any other genuine additional costs. Its earlier arming was separately paid. |
| **Delay Spell:** a locked target moves behind a real wall before release | The now-blocked effect fails without refund or substitute target. It is not another cast or Counterspell window. |
| **Mirror versus mirror** | The first eligible ward redirects the root once. The second ward is neither consumed nor used to redirect it again. |
| **Gentle Repose:** corpse was already 23 hours 50 minutes dead; the party waits another 20 minutes | Physical preservation does not keep that corpse inside Death Whisper/Lesser Dead’s new 24-hour actual-death admission window. Other completed question procedures retain their own limits. |
| **Enlarge/Reduce:** an admitted unscaled body has 10 lb mass | The NEW linear scaling produces **33.75 lb** when enlarged or **1.25 lb** when reduced. Recasts use the non-Enlarge/Reduce baseline, not a multiplied magical snapshot. No HP, proficiency or resource refill follows. |
| **Magic Mouth speaks near a device** | The sound may satisfy an actually configured acoustic trigger. It does not supply a controller, their Action/Bonus Action, a valid command channel or an unused shared offensive allowance. |

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="9"}[Complete worked boundaries](sandbox:/mnt/data/low_rank_reviewer/LR_WORKED_BOUNDARIES.json)

## Earlier rules kept, and the precise new exception

The **54 class-interface dispositions** are individual, not a blanket “same name means compatible” rule. They preserve, among other things, Oracle’s RC and component exceptions, Druid’s actual Shapeshift/Refrain and ritual rules, Paladin’s different silence/oath windows, existing invisibility endings, concentration protections and companion budgets.

**The substantive shared-rule exception added here is Haste’s narrowly scoped voluntary ending cost.** It is named and limited in LR-C10/R3-12. The other NEW common procedures complete these previously nonoperative ordinary spells; they do not silently rewrite the fulfilled language, teaching or crafting rules.

All **114 complete spell counterparts** retain their actual records and statuses: 83 operative comparisons and 31 nonoperative comparisons. No pending comparison becomes available because it appears in this conference.

### 4. Give copying and delayed casting real action and resource histories

**NEW — LR-G13 and UN-05/14/17/21:**

**Cantrip Echo** is one composite Bonus Action casting of the eligible payload. It uses the payload’s ordinary spell ID for its actual casting history, rather than inserting a wrapper name to reset Refrain. It makes a fresh legal attack/save where required; it does not replay a saved successful result.

**Quick Cast** spends its own Bonus Action to prepare a conversion on the caster’s **next regular turn**. It does not supply two Bonus Actions in the preparation turn. The later payload consumes that turn’s real Bonus Action and pays its actual costs.

**Delay Spell** has separate arming and payload commitments. Holding the already committed payload uses concentration for no more than six seconds. Targets and selections are locked; release revalidates current range, line and eligibility. Release is not a second casting or a new Counterspell window.

**Echo Cast** is separately paid arming followed by a real Action replay on the next regular turn. Only base RP is waived.

These wrappers cannot recursively take one another or an already replayed payload as replay fuel. Existing acquired class exceptions retain their own actual predicates; they are not automatically absorbed into this wrapper family.

### 5. Keep different invisibility and control endings different

**Ordinary Invisibility, IL-22, retains its printed action-ending clause.** The NEW precise boundary is before commitment of an Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. It does not automatically end merely from movement or another event that is not such an action.

That rule is **not** imposed on Cloak of Shades, Mislead, Shadow Dive, Dreamer’s Veil or other distinct class sources. Each keeps its own specified ending.

Consequently, ordinary IL-22 alone does not satisfy **Unseen Hand’s** requirement to take an Action **while Invisible**: this spell has already ended at the relevant commitment. An independently acquired invisibility source that actually persists through that Action can still qualify under the class card and its shared budget.

**Haste, R3-12, receives one explicitly named exception.** It retains its printed extra **full Action**, rather than an imported restricted action menu, while respecting the existing one-extra-full-Action-per-creature-per-numbered-round limit.

Its ending Stun is retained as a **NEW informed, voluntarily accepted buff-ending cost**, not another hostile hard-control claim. Actual expiry, concentration loss, dispel, replacement or dismissal triggers it; temporary suppression alone does not. Actual Stunned immunity still applies. This exception does **not** extend to other hostile denial effects.

### 6. Reflection redirects one effect; it does not create another cast

**NEW — LR-G14, Spell Mirror and Soul Mirror:**

The first eligible resolving ordinary spell with the protected creature as its **sole direct creature recipient** can be intercepted, whether beneficial or hostile. A Touch spell can qualify through this explicit magical return when the original caster is otherwise a legal recipient.

Area, multitarget, self-only, object/anchor, summoning, ongoing-tick and already redirected effects do not qualify.

The original caster remains the spell owner and supplies its statistics. The ward spends before the returned effect resolves. **An illegal or blocked return spends the ward but leaves the original recipient; it does not cancel the spell for free.** A causal root can be redirected only once by these two spells. A second mirror neither redirects nor consumes itself on that already redirected root.

### 7. Preserve finite damage, corpses, material and created bodies

Every ongoing damage spell now has an explicit number of checkpoints, ending procedure and suppression treatment. Suppressed scheduled ticks are spent, not banked for later. Extra turns do not manufacture more regular-turn ticks.

**Soul Tap** uses one d6 for the damage and both transfer ceilings. Its NEW transfer funding requires actual underlying normal-HP loss to a genuinely hostile living nonconstruct opponent. HP recovery is bounded by that actual loss and ordinary healing limits. RP transfer is separately bounded by the same roll, the donor’s actual available RP and the caster’s actual missing RP after payment. **RC is not RP.**

These new funding choices do not retrospectively rewrite the nonidentical completed Lifedraw, Vampiric Touch or feat procedures.

**Pact of Bone’s “+2 necrotic resist”** becomes a NEW flat reduction of two, not another resistance percentage. Its new reduction stage is expressly placed after the save amount and before passive resistance/vulnerability.

Corpse questions, corpse preservation, animation and ordinary harvesting retain distinct histories. Gentle Repose does not restart a death timestamp or a question/admission deadline. New corpse-fueled assets do not leave a fresh resource pool when their terminal history says the original matter was consumed.

Shadow Blade, Phantom Steed, Corpse Puppet, Summon Bone Archer, Summon Dreadknight and Animate Dead receive their own finite body, defense, movement, attack or noncombat-task, capacity, command and ending profiles. **No unsupplied monster stat block, equipment, ammunition, corpse loot or autonomous production is imported.**

Material transformations retain actual mass lineage, damage, ownership and old acquisition claims. Enlarge/Reduce does not compound repeated magical snapshots or refill HP. Stone Shape supplies bounded elementary shapes from actual stone, not a free fine mechanism, repaired structure or authored crafting result.

Several source choices are unusual but are **not corrected to another game’s familiar version**:

- **Primal Savagery:** the literal 30-foot range is retained through a NEW momentary spell-local claw extension for one spell attack, not permanent natural-weapon reach.
